name: Verify Verbal Reasoning
description: Measures a candidate's ability to understand and critically evaluate written information. Suitable for graduate and managerial roles requiring strong language comprehension.

name: Verify Numerical Reasoning
description: Assesses the ability to make correct decisions or inferences from numerical and statistical data. Ideal for roles requiring quantitative reasoning.

name: Verify Inductive Reasoning
description: Measures the ability to identify patterns and rules within abstract diagrammatic information. Relevant for roles requiring complex problem-solving and innovation.

name: Verify Deductive Reasoning
description: Evaluates the ability to draw logical conclusions from written information. Measures structured, systematic thinking relevant to analytical roles.

name: Verify Mechanical Comprehension
description: Assesses understanding of mechanical and physical concepts. Suited for engineering, maintenance, and technical trade roles.

name: Verify Spatial Reasoning
description: Measures the ability to visualise and mentally manipulate 2D and 3D shapes. Relevant for engineering, design, and architecture roles.

name: Verify Data Checking
description: Assesses speed and accuracy when checking data against given criteria. Used for clerical and data-entry roles.

name: Verify Checking
description: Measures accuracy and speed when checking information. Relevant for administrative and operational roles requiring attention to detail.

name: OPQ32r
description: The Occupational Personality Questionnaire (OPQ32r) measures 32 personality characteristics that affect workplace performance. Used for selection, development and succession planning at all levels.

name: OPQ32n
description: Normative version of the Occupational Personality Questionnaire. Provides a detailed profile of an individual's preferred behavioral style in the workplace.

name: MQ (Motivation Questionnaire)
description: Assesses the conditions that increase or decrease an individual's motivation in the workplace. Helps understand what drives and engages candidates.

name: General Ability Test
description: Broad measure of cognitive ability covering verbal, numerical and abstract reasoning. Suitable for a wide range of job levels.

name: Graduate Managerial Assessment
description: Comprehensive cognitive assessment designed for graduate and managerial level positions requiring complex reasoning and analytical thinking.

name: Critical Reasoning Test Battery (CRTB2)
description: Measures verbal and numerical critical reasoning for managerial and professional roles. Tests ability to evaluate written arguments and numerical data.

name: Watson Glaser Critical Thinking Appraisal
description: Measures ability to distinguish between facts and inferences, evaluate arguments, and draw logical conclusions. Widely used for legal, financial, and leadership roles.

name: Situational Judgement Test
description: Presents realistic workplace scenarios and assesses how candidates respond. Measures practical judgement and job-relevant behaviors.

name: Customer Contact Styles Questionnaire
description: Assesses behavioral preferences relevant to customer-facing roles. Useful for customer service, sales, and call centre positions.

name: Sales Aptitude Assessment
description: Evaluates a candidate's natural aptitude for sales roles including drive, persuasion, resilience, and customer orientation.

name: Java (Advanced Level)
description: Advanced-level Java programming assessment covering OOP, data structures, concurrency, design patterns, and Java EE concepts.

name: Java 8 (New)
description: Assesses Java 8 features including lambdas, streams, Optional, CompletableFuture, and functional programming concepts.

name: Python (New)
description: Comprehensive Python assessment covering language fundamentals, data structures, OOP, standard library, and Pythonic coding practices.

name: JavaScript (New)
description: Evaluates JavaScript proficiency including ES6+ features, DOM manipulation, async programming, closures, and modern JS patterns.

name: SQL (New)
description: Tests SQL knowledge including queries, joins, subqueries, aggregations, stored procedures, and database design concepts.

name: .NET (C#) (New)
description: Assesses .NET and C# programming skills including object-oriented concepts, LINQ, async/await, and .NET framework knowledge.

name: C++ (New)
description: Evaluates C++ proficiency covering STL, memory management, templates, OOP, and modern C++11/14/17 features.

name: React (New)
description: Assesses React.js skills including hooks, component lifecycle, state management, JSX, and React ecosystem knowledge.

name: Angular
description: Tests Angular framework knowledge including components, services, dependency injection, routing, and RxJS.

name: Node.js (New)
description: Evaluates Node.js skills including event loop, async patterns, Express.js, npm ecosystem, and server-side JavaScript.

name: Machine Learning
description: Tests machine learning concepts including supervised/unsupervised learning, model evaluation, feature engineering, and algorithm selection.

name: Data Science
description: Comprehensive data science assessment covering statistics, Python/R, data wrangling, visualization, and machine learning fundamentals.

name: Agile Software Development
description: Evaluates understanding of Agile principles, Scrum, Kanban, sprint planning, retrospectives, and agile team dynamics.

name: Project Management
description: Assesses project management knowledge covering planning, risk management, budgeting, stakeholder management, and PMI/PRINCE2 frameworks.

name: Business Analysis
description: Tests business analysis skills including requirements gathering, process modeling, use cases, and stakeholder communication.

name: Financial Acumen
description: Evaluates financial literacy including reading P&L statements, balance sheets, cash flow, and fundamental financial analysis.

name: Workplace Safety
description: Assesses knowledge of health and safety regulations, risk assessment, hazard identification, and safe working practices.

name: Entry Level Customer Service
description: Situational judgement and aptitude test for entry-level customer service roles. Measures service orientation, problem-solving, and communication.

name: Managerial and Professional Learning Styles Questionnaire
description: Explores preferred learning approaches to support personal development planning for managers and professionals.

name: Leadership Report
description: Derived from OPQ32, this report profiles leadership potential across key dimensions including strategic thinking, execution, and people skills.

name: Universal Competency Framework (UCF)
description: SHL's competency framework linking personality traits to 8 universal competencies and 20 specific competencies relevant for selection and development.

name: Occupational Personality Questionnaire 360
description: 360-degree feedback instrument based on OPQ competencies. Gathers multi-rater feedback for individual development planning.

name: Call Center Simulation
description: Simulates real call center tasks to assess candidate ability to handle customer queries, follow procedures, and multitask effectively.

name: Personality-based Emotional Intelligence
description: Measures emotional intelligence dimensions including self-awareness, empathy, and social effectiveness in the workplace.

name: Remote Worker Profiling
description: Assesses a candidate's suitability and readiness for remote or hybrid work environments, covering self-management, communication, and autonomy.

name: Administrative Professional
description: Tests skills and abilities relevant to administrative and support roles including data accuracy, written communication, and task prioritization.

name: Resilience Questionnaire
description: Assesses ability to deal with pressure, setbacks, and change. Useful for high-pressure roles and identifying burnout risk.

name: SHL Coding Pro - Python
description: Practical coding simulation for Python developers. Candidates write and debug real code to assess hands-on programming ability.

name: SHL Coding Pro - Java
description: Practical coding simulation for Java developers. Tests real-world Java programming including debugging, refactoring, and algorithm implementation.

name: SHL Coding Pro - JavaScript
description: Hands-on JavaScript coding assessment where candidates solve real problems to demonstrate front-end and full-stack development skills.

name: Transactional Manager Assessment
description: Comprehensive assessment for frontline and transactional managers combining cognitive ability and personality measurement.

name: Sales Representative Solution
description: Assessment battery for sales representative roles covering sales aptitude, personality, and situational judgement scenarios.

name: Verbal Ability
description: Tests language comprehension, grammar, and vocabulary. Suitable for roles requiring strong written and verbal communication.

name: Numerical Ability
description: Tests basic to intermediate numerical skills including arithmetic, percentages, ratios, and interpretation of charts.

name: Entry Level Cognitive Battery
description: Designed for entry-level and operational roles. Measures basic cognitive skills required for clerical, manufacturing, and service jobs.

name: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
description: Tests foundational cybersecurity knowledge including threats, vulnerabilities, network security, encryption, and security policies.

name: DevOps (New)
description: Evaluates DevOps knowledge covering CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), infrastructure as code, and monitoring.

name: Cloud Computing (AWS)
description: Tests knowledge of Amazon Web Services including compute, storage, networking, security, and cloud architecture best practices.

name: Service Desk Analyst
description: Assesses IT support knowledge combined with situational judgement for service desk and helpdesk analyst roles.

name: Global Skills Assessment
description: Broad assessment measuring core workplace skills across cognitive ability, professional knowledge, and behavioral competencies.
